trips.name: Montserrat
trips.geocode_query: Montserrat Monastery, Monistrol de Montserrat, Catalonia, Spain
trips.description: Take the R5 train from Plaça Espanya plus the rack railway (Cremallera) or cable car up to the mountain-top Benedictine monastery, home to the Black Madonna, with scenic hiking trails and views of the jagged peaks.

trips.name: Girona
trips.geocode_query: Girona Old Town, Girona, Catalonia, Spain
trips.description: A high-speed or regional train from Barcelona Sants takes about 40–75 minutes to this medieval city with its colorful Onyar River houses, Jewish Quarter (El Call), cathedral and city walls.

trips.name: Sitges
trips.description: A 35-minute R2 Sud train ride from Barcelona Sants brings you to a charming seaside town with golden beaches, a whitewashed old town, and a lively promenade.
